title: 3.8 Graphing Absolute Value Functions

icans: I can graph absolute value functions and find their range.
I can describe and write transformations of f(x) = |x|.
I can find the vertex of an absolute value function.

vocab: the point where the graph changes ____________

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Vertex: g(x) = a|x − h| + k has vertex _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph g(x) = |x + 2| − 3. Give the vertex and the range.
Find the vertex of h(x) = −2|x − 1| + 4. Does it open up or down? Give the range.

tickets.stem: Does y = −|x| open up or down?
